welcome1: Welcome to Forth Canoe Club. We're a local, open, active, and friendly kayaking / canoeing club, right in the heart of Edinburgh. We can't wait to have you join us on the water!
welcome2: If you're a complete beginner or a bit scared to start, don't let that get in the way — that's what we're here for!
welcome3: We also cater to experienced, adventurous paddlers, already involved in a specific discipline or keen to compete.

welcome4After: — usually held on the first Thursday of every month.
startIntro: Here are a few useful details:
start1: marks our clubhouse on Edinburgh's Union Canal, where many of our activities take place.
start3: Children need to be 8 or older to join a kids class or to paddle in a one-person boat. Children under 8 can come to an open night, paddling together with a supervising adult in an open canoe.
start4: Young people under 16 must be supervised by an accompanying adult at club nights.

missionIntro: Forth Canoe Club is a registered Scottish Charity (SC050275) and is set up for the advancement of public participation in sport. In particular we seek to do the following:
mission1: Foster, develop and advance public participation in paddle sports
mission2: For the practice of the sport of canoeing and kayaking. We support club members to gain awards, provide training and coaching, and provide opportunities for members to try different water sports activities.
mission3Title: Increase participation for individuals with disabilities
mission3: To strive to increase participation in sport and recreation for individuals with disabilities or those facing barriers to other sports, by creating supportive environments, providing necessary resources, and championing adaptive sports initiatives.
quick1Body: Come along to one of our beginner sessions — no experience needed. We provide all kit and coaching. Your first 3 trial sessions are free.
quick2Body: Membership runs from 1 March each year. Subscribe for coached sessions, kit hire and access to our full programme of events and trips.
quick3Body: Our club runs on volunteers. Help with coaching, events, maintenance or administration and earn discount codes for your membership.
